title: Constructive vs analytic handles on the same Habiro object
html: The polynomial-ring path is constructive (the Habiro coefficients a_m(u) are computed by sequential cyclotomic division, see Atomic-braid Habiro expansion: integrality and termination) while the residue path is analytic (it requires the quantum dilogarithm \Phi_q and complex-analytic residues at primitive roots of unity). The equivalence shows the two viewpoints are two computational handles on the same underlying object in the Habiro ring, and lets later proofs use whichever is more tractable without losing rigour.
